A cold blue residual emergency glow seeps from dying floor-strips, deep shadow swallowing everything above, the air thick with drifting dust.
A single failing red alert light pulses slowly in the dark, throwing the corridor into stuttering crimson and black.
Hard shafts of starlight lance through a hull breach into the gloom, cutting bright blades through the floating dust.
Total blackness but for the explorer's beam, a single hard cone of light with deep void pressing in on every side.
A sickly green chemical glow bleeds from a ruptured conduit, casting corpse-light across buckled walls and pooling on the grated floor.
Near-total darkness, only the faintest rim-light tracing the edges of wreckage in cold silver, everything else consumed by black.
A dying overhead strip flickers in long agonal stutters, each flash revealing the corridor for a half-second before darkness reclaims it.
Cold white light pours from one surviving panel, a hard clinical rectangle in the black, throwing everything behind it into absolute shadow.
An amber gloom filters through dust-choked vents, thick and warm and wrong, turning the drifting particles to slow falling embers.
Deep blue starlight floods through a fractured viewport, reflecting off every surface in cold silence, the shadows behind it absolute.
A strobing short-circuit throws rapid stutters of white light down the passage, each flash freezing drifting debris in jagged snapshot.
Bioluminescent spill from a cracked specimen tank washes one wall in pale teal, the glow too soft to reach the ceiling.
A single maintenance drone drifts, its small work-light sweeping mechanically through black air thick with particulate, finding nothing alive.
Molten orange from a slow interior fire seeps under a sealed bulkhead door, pulsing gently, heat-shimmer warping the air above it.
Ultraviolet strips left running in a decontamination bay cast everything in bone-white and violet shadow, dust motes burning like slow sparks.
Console screens frozen on their last readout throw cold multicolored pixel-glow across the operator's empty chair, the rest of the room black.
A faint phosphorescent smear on the wall, origin unknown, gives just enough light to see the handprint beside it.
Distant through a collapsed hatchway, emergency lighting still holds in a far compartment, its blue glow a tiny cold rectangle in the dark.
Infrared sensor-strips pulse invisibly except where escaping gas catches the frequency, drawing bright ghostly columns rising to the dark ceiling.
A cracked porthole leaks a thin blade of raw sunlight, so intense it burns a white scar across the floor into shadow.
Red and green navigation beacons outside strobe silently through the viewport glass, painting slow alternating washes of color across the dead interior.
A holographic display flickers half-alive, its ghostly blue projection stuttering in and out, casting shifting translucent shapes on the far wall.
Darkness complete except for the soft amber of a dying battery indicator on the floor, a tiny eye blinking slower and slower.
Welding sparks cascade in slow motion from a severed cable above, each one a brief bright life in the surrounding black.
The glow of cooling reactor glass, deep and furnace-red behind thick shielding, pressing heat-light through every crack in the chamber walls.
